# anthropic_rbac_roles (Data Source)

Lists all available Claude Enterprise RBAC roles in the organization (`/v1/organizations/rbac_roles`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) List of RBAC roles in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the role was created.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the RBAC role.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the RBAC role.
- `name` (String) Name of the RBAC role.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the role was last updated.
